readerProblem: Assuming buyer volume automatically translates into favorable terms without representational governance or exit rights.

propositionLedger.statement: Volume without ratification creates intermediary lock-in rather than buyer leverage.
Suppliers capture volume concessions when buyer exit rights are restricted.
Scale without structural authority is an atomized queue, not a market position.

prohibitedInterpretations: Do not claim that large groups cannot benefit from scale under proper governance.
Do not claim that aggregation is universally harmful.
claimBoundary: Theoretical framework at Evidence Level E0. No price assertions on commercial goods.
handoff: Prepares the commitment asymmetry analysis for Module 04.
